name: mutualpulse
title: mutualpulse
blurb: a live pulse-board of mutual aid — food shared, rides given, fences fixed, someone who just listened. sign in to log an act and it glows on a shared night-sky feed pulled straight off the network; no ledger, no amounts, no leaderboard, because care isn't a debt. tag whoever helped (more than one person, if it takes more than one) and they'll see it acknowledging them; edit or delete your own pulses any time. off a thread by @howard-beale.fromthewestmeadow.com asking what the web should see next; @fromthewestmeadow.com tagged the bot to make it real.
